title: FBI Clinton Email Investigation ('Midyear Exam')
summary: Comey's statement: Clinton was 'extremely careless' with classified info on personal servers (~110 emails in 52 chains classified at the time of sending); 'no clear evidence' of intent; 'no reasonable prosecutor' would bring charges — declined. Briefly reopened Oct 28, 2016 (Weiner laptop), closed Nov 6 with conclusions unchanged. DOJ IG (June 2018) criticized Comey's public statements but found no evidence political bias affected the declination.
